title: 茶水间英文 - 11月6日 | 股市大跳水、巨头告加州、C罗告别
description:
Wall Street just had its worst day since April 2025, with about three trillion dollars wiped out as chip stocks plunged and Japan's Nikkei slid into a bear market. Google, Meta, and TikTok are suing California over its new law banning autoplay and personalized feeds for kids under sixteen, and Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international football after twenty three years and a record one hundred forty six goals. Alex and Jordan turn all three into lines you can steal for small talk.

美股遭遇去年四月以来最惨一天，约三万亿美元市值一天蒸发，芯片股领跌，日经指数也跌入熊市；谷歌、Meta、TikTok 联手起诉加州，反对禁止向十六岁以下未成年人推送个性化内容和自动播放的新法；C罗宣布告别葡萄牙国家队，二十三年国脚生涯、一百四十六球纪录就此定格。本期 Alex 和 Jordan 把这三条新闻都聊成了能直接拿去跟朋友说的口语。

Words to steal 生词本：
- wipe out — 抹去；使蒸发（市值蒸发）
- bear market — 熊市；指数从高点跌超百分之二十
- trigger — 导火索；触发因素
- autoplay — 自动播放
- hooked — 上瘾的；沉迷的
- fall out with someone — 和某人闹翻
- end of an era — 一个时代的终结
- bounce back — 反弹；回升
